description: Natural-language prompts for exercising the scryfall-search skill. Each eval lists substrings a correct Scryfall query should contain. Operator order and case do not matter; these are guidance, not strict assertions.

evals.prompt: Find me all the blue instants.
What mythic rare planeswalkers are there?
evals.notes: Rarity name passed directly to r:.

evals.prompt: List goblin cards that aren't creatures.
Red dragons with flying that cost 5 or less.
evals.notes: 'Cost 5 or less' is mana value. Flying via o:flying or kw:flying.

evals.prompt: White creatures with power 4 or greater that are legal in Standard.
evals.notes: Numeric comparison on pow; f: for format legality.

evals.prompt: Two-color artifact creatures that cost under two dollars.
Find me all the legendary creatures with deathtouch that cost 3 or less.
Cards I can play in a Golgari commander deck.
evals.notes: Commander question -> color identity (id<=bg or id<=golgari), not color.

evals.prompt: Cheap red burn spells legal in Modern.
evals.notes: 'Burn' -> oracle text 'damage'. 'Cheap' is subjective; a mv<=2 or mv<=3 threshold is reasonable and should be stated to the user.
'Board wipe' / 'wrath' has no operator; match o:"destroy all". Exile-based or damage-based wipes may be missed - acceptable for a first pass.
ETB -> oracle phrase 'when ~ enters'. The ~ placeholder stands for the card name.

evals.prompt: Find tutors - cards that search your library.
evals.notes: 'Tutor' -> o:"search your library". Excluding lands (-t:land) avoids fetchlands and basics.

evals.prompt: Find green or colorless creatures that grant haste.
evals.notes: 'Green or colorless' is a card pool -> color IDENTITY (id<=g), not printed color (c<=g). c: matches Devoid Eldrazi, which are printed colorless but carry a colored color identity and can't go in a green/colorless deck. id<=g correctly excludes them.
